title: Laser Voting
shortDescription: The audience answers by pointing a laser at the screen. Every dot counts as a vote, and the result builds up live in front of the whole room.
longDescription: A crowd voting format where each guest gets a laser pointer and answers a question by aiming at one of the options projected on screen. Every laser dot is counted as a vote, a countdown keeps the energy up, and the result appears live, so the room sees its own opinion take shape within seconds. It works for quick polls, A/B decisions, quiz rounds, or moderated debates, and scales from a meeting room to a full auditorium. Questions, answer layouts, timing, and visuals are configurable and can be steered by a host on stage. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: No Phones, Full Attention
highlights.description: Nobody has to unlock a phone, find the Wi-Fi, or open a link. Guests just point, which keeps eyes on the stage and gets even the least tech-savvy people in the room voting.

highlights.title: A Room Full of Light
highlights.description: Hundreds of laser dots dancing across the screen are a show in themselves, turning a routine poll into a visual moment that photographers and attendees capture.

highlights.title: A Host's Best Friend
highlights.description: Moderators get instant, visible answers to steer the conversation, break the ice at the start, or settle a debate on the spot, which makes it an easy upsell for any staged programme.

highlights.title: More Than Yes or No
highlights.description: Add multi-option grids, team-versus-team rounds, a quiz mode with points per correct answer, heat maps of where the room pointed, or a live comparison between two halls.

highlights.title: Votes in Any Setting
highlights.description: Run it as a game show for a sales kick-off, a strategy check at a shareholder meeting, a light-saber duel at a sci-fi themed gala, or a festive quiz at the company Christmas party.

highlights.title: The Room's Opinion, on Record
highlights.description: Add a data layer that saves every question with its vote split and timing, so the client leaves with an exportable snapshot of what the audience actually thought.

highlights.title: Part of the Show
highlights.description: Pair with Live Quiz Show for a full game format, with Live Feed to put results on every screen in the venue, or with Prize Draw to reward the room after the final question.
